subject: folding-fan character
art_direction: 半圆折扇成为宽脸角色，蓝红扇面分区，短腿并拢，侧目像在听冷笑话。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Build a character from a half-open folding fan with a broad semicircular face and very short joined legs. Alternate large cobalt and vermilion panels across the fan, leaving a cream central wedge for a small dryly amused expression. The lower pivot forms a tiny button-like chin. Turn the body slightly so one edge narrows, but keep the illustration entirely flat. Use broad brush contours and selective cutout gaps, not physical paper shadows. Set it on warm ivory with no floral ornament, lettering, or human hands. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
